mpv_abort_async_command.rationale: triggers cancellation synchronously; a custom stream the request opened runs its cancel_fn during the call

mpv_client_id.rationale: reads a field of the handle; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_client_name.rationale: reads a field of the handle; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_command.rationale: takes the core lock and runs the command on the calling thread, then waits for it to finish (unbounded); may run wakeup callbacks synchronously

mpv_command_async.rationale: returns without waiting for the core, but takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback

mpv_command_node.rationale: takes the core lock and runs the command on the calling thread, then waits for it to finish (unbounded); may run wakeup callbacks synchronously

mpv_command_node_async.rationale: returns without waiting for the core, but takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback

mpv_command_ret.rationale: takes the core lock and runs the command on the calling thread, then waits for it to finish (unbounded); may run wakeup callbacks synchronously

mpv_command_string.rationale: takes the core lock and runs the command on the calling thread, then waits for it to finish (unbounded); may run wakeup callbacks synchronously

mpv_create.rationale: allocates a whole player core and starts its thread; nothing can be registered yet, so it cannot call back

mpv_create_client.rationale: takes the client-list lock, which mpv holds while running wakeup callbacks for broadcast events

mpv_create_weak_client.rationale: takes the client-list lock, which mpv holds while running wakeup callbacks for broadcast events

mpv_del_property.rationale: runs the del command synchronously; blocks and calls back like mpv_command

mpv_destroy.rationale: blocks on pending async requests and, for the last strong handle, on core shutdown; prefer the Safe alias, an unsafe call stalls every capability and GC meanwhile

mpv_error_string.rationale: returns a static string; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_event_name.rationale: returns a static string; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_event_to_node.rationale: copies the event into freshly allocated nodes; cannot block or call back

mpv_free.rationale: frees memory the API returned; cannot block or call back

mpv_free_node_contents.rationale: frees the memory a node references; cannot block or call back

mpv_get_property.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and runs the getter on the calling thread; some getters wait on your render thread

mpv_get_property_async.rationale: returns without waiting for the core, but takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback

mpv_get_property_osd_string.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and runs the getter on the calling thread; some getters wait on your render thread

mpv_get_property_string.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and runs the getter on the calling thread; some getters wait on your render thread

mpv_get_time_ns.rationale: reads a monotonic clock value; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_get_time_us.rationale: reads a monotonic clock value; cannot block, lock, or call back

mpv_get_wakeup_pipe.rationale: takes the wakeup lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback; creates the pipe on first use

mpv_hook_add.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) to register the handler

mpv_hook_continue.rationale: takes the core lock, then sends MPV_EVENT_HOOK to the next handler, running its wakeup callback synchronously

mpv_initialize.rationale: initializes the player on the calling thread (config files, scripts, force-window); prefer the Safe alias, an unsafe call stalls every capability and GC meanwhile

mpv_load_config_file.rationale: takes the core lock and parses the file on the calling thread (blocking file I/O)

mpv_observe_property.rationale: takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback; never waits for the core

mpv_render_context_create.rationale: calls get_proc_address from mpv_opengl_init_params synchronously while loading OpenGL functions

mpv_render_context_free.rationale: if video is active, blocks until the core has torn down the video chain, serving the render queue meanwhile

mpv_render_context_get_info.rationale: reads the queued frame under the render context lock, which the VO thread holds only briefly

mpv_render_context_render.rationale: blocks until the frame's target display time unless MPV_RENDER_PARAM_BLOCK_FOR_TARGET_TIME is 0

mpv_render_context_report_swap.rationale: signals the VO thread under the render context lock, which the VO thread holds only briefly

mpv_render_context_set_parameter.rationale: a changed ICC profile reinitializes the renderer on the calling thread

mpv_render_context_update.rationale: runs pending render-thread work on the calling thread, including decoder texture allocation with MPV_RENDER_PARAM_ADVANCED_CONTROL

mpv_request_event.rationale: takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback; never waits for the core

mpv_request_log_messages.rationale: runs the registered wakeup callback synchronously

mpv_set_option.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and applies the option on the calling thread

mpv_set_option_string.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and applies the option on the calling thread

mpv_set_property.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and runs the setter on the calling thread

mpv_set_property_async.rationale: returns without waiting for the core, but takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback

mpv_set_property_string.rationale: takes the core lock (an unbounded wait, per client.h) and runs the setter on the calling thread

mpv_stream_cb_add_ro.rationale: registration; open_fn and the stream callbacks it installs fire later on mpv's threads

mpv_terminate_destroy.rationale: quits the player and blocks until every other handle and the core are gone; prefer the Safe alias, an unsafe call stalls every capability and GC meanwhile

mpv_unobserve_property.rationale: takes the handle's lock, which mpv holds while running the wakeup callback; never waits for the core

mpv_wait_async_requests.rationale: blocks until every async request has replied; prefer the Safe alias, an unsafe call stalls every capability and GC meanwhile

mpv_wait_event.rationale: blocks up to the timeout (negative waits forever); prefer the Safe alias, an unsafe call stalls every capability and GC meanwhile

mpv_wakeup.rationale: runs the registered wakeup callback synchronously
